explanation.surface: It is payday for a seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: An old salt is an experienced seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: Salt, usually 'old salt', is informal for a veteran seaman, someone seasoned by the sea.

clue.text: Religious house never going to perish on its own

parts.note: a FRIARY houses friars; the preamble's ending ARY is removed in the grid
what will never perish is everlasting

explanation.surface: A monastery that will stand for ever, all by itself.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole surface seems to describe one immortal building; it splits into two pieces and a definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone friendless has no companions, so is left alone, isolated, by themselves.

clue.text: Finished without stuttering nonconformist being used in anatomy lesson?

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one piece wraps around another

parts.note: to die is to be finished
a SECTARY is a dissenter, given a stammered first letter; the preamble's ending ARY is removed in the grid

explanation.surface: A dissenter who no longer stammers ends up as the specimen in an anatomy class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without stuttering' reads as fluent speech, but 'without' means outside and the stutter doubles a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Bodies studied in anatomy classes are cut apart to examine their structure, so a cadaver there has been dissected.
